purpose: Lets the person type a single line of text, picking a Type for what the value holds (phone, currency, password, url, search and more) so the field brings the right parts and keyboard. Wrap it in a Field with a label.

notFor.case: Text that runs over one line, such as a message or description.
A small numeric value stepped up and down.
Several free values entered as tags.
Picking a value from a known list, with or without search.

Default.visual: Surface/input box with a Border/control edge; value in Content/primary, placeholder and icons in Content/subtle.

Focused.visual: Border/focus edge with a Border/ring/default ring.

Invalid.visual: Status/critical/border-strong edge with a Status/critical/border ring.

Disabled.visual: Action/disabled/default fill; text, placeholder, icons and add-on in Content/disabled.

a11y.role: textbox (native <input>, with inputmode and autofill hint per Type)
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the field; typing edits it. Parts that are buttons (Browse, Copy, the password toggle) and the select add-on are their own tab stops.
notes: Pair it with a FieldLabel (htmlFor) or an aria-label.
The select add-on is a native <select> with its own name; the shortcut keys are <kbd>.
The edge moves with use-hover and the ring with use-focus.

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the edge and ring transitions (use-hover, use-focus) be instant with reduced motion?
Value colour: Figma paints the field's text Content/subtle in 99 variants, the contract uses Content/primary. Which is right? (finding PAR-001 Input text.text)
Invalid message: the error text comes from Field. Should Input ever show an invalid glyph itself, as Textarea does?
